native carry uses the actual forward body path, then lowers and releases before recovery
native drop owns the real release palm; flight and landing do not pull the arm toward the floor
contact angular approach/recovery has zero endpoint speed and keeps one elbow branch; owned exit and entry retain grip
unreachable/folded grips, wrong poles and source timing remain blocking errors without target repair

independent source heads and bald/haired supporting identities remain their own while native bodies operate

projection conserves complete original hand ownership and timings through five camera slices
fractional existing default ramps round-trip by omission without rounding at a cut
invalid original commands and clocks cannot be concealed by an empty local slice
local edits do not mutate another slice or the authored target/source span
source span is strict original motion timing, with complete ordered approach/hold/recovery and no implicit ID inference
all exact source pieces bind one physical hand/action/target/pole/window; real missing/duplicate fragments fail
approach, hold and recovery cuts preserve both actor/view/hand trajectories and painter slots against a complete original clip
seeking source trajectories out of order is deterministic and the nonowned hand keeps its actual body rest state
ordinary adjacent gestures never become a source command and explicit cuts cannot carry an incomplete declared span
missing/stale context, incompatible profiles and contact/prop timing cannot silently approximate a source gesture
overlapping source commands or an ordinary clip on the same owned hand fail, while the other hand can be independent
cache/repair input identity includes nonlocal command timing and actual replacement, with no discarded old approval
compiler source grid/refinement and namespaced ink/hand layers use original gesture phases without fake contact
canonical paired source gestures preserve a speaking actor across primary/supporting switch and report original target timing
creative normalization keeps complete native source context, registered image resources and cast continuity across primary swap [P2]
artwork repair and rejected/completed replay use the full current source board without a new provider call or stale sibling binding [P2]
native source gesture readiness remains unapproved and full input/video production gates stay active
native seated rest arms retain their own cuff/palm bones and original phase through cuts and reverse seeks
source seats are bounded, explicit and compatible with old unsupported body sources
sit preparation, held contact, rise, later gait and cloth/hair retain the complete original phase through camera cuts
occupancy clips the original approach/hold/rise to local time and preserves exclusive world geometry
source/support and sibling edits invalidate publication; missing/hidden/cut/local sources cannot synthesize continuity
baked support boundaries, reports and camera/preview refer to the original seat clock
single-actor framing fits the whole source seat including its shadow and backrest
canonical objectless two-actor seated run retains original clocks through primary and speaking/listening changes
an inactive seat preserves the exact standing solve without evaluating its lap target
angular seat transfer stays on fixed bones where a straight wrist path crosses the inner annulus
seat arm transfer uses the supplied weight once and remains deterministic under reverse seeks and scaling
unreachable, invalid and unsupported seat keyposes require authored correction without clamping the targets
wrapped endpoint directions retain one continuous numeric branch for baked arm rotations
